top_strength: Zhang gathered comprehensive logistics details across both properties (bedrooms, square footage, parking, access, special considerations, packing scope) and correctly identified the 1,800 sq ft threshold to route to a virtual walkthrough rather than quote on the call.
coaching_note: Ask 'Their Agenda' (concerns and what they want answered) BEFORE launching into logistics probing—it currently came after multiple questions about property type and size, which dilutes its discovery power.
